items.html: And the discerning will understand, and will compare one matter to another, how in all the emanated worlds, those that shine into the world below them are always the discernment of the lower half of Tifferet and NHY. For we find how the lower half of Tifferet and NHY of ZA shine in his Nukva; and NHY of AA and of AVI shine to ZA; and NHY of Atik to AA. And likewise this Tifferet and NHY of AK shine to Atik and to the whole world of Atzilut, as will be explained. From this it will further be explained to you that at every time when lights are brought out in order to emanate them, the matter of restriction is required. And it will be explained below in its place how AA, too, restricted the lights of his NHY in order to emanate ZA and his Nukva; and this is enough for one who understands.
